title: U.S. customs declaration - returning travelers
facts: Travelers entering the United States must comply with CBP declaration requirements for articles acquired abroad and other reportable items.
Items obtained abroad, gifts and purchases can need to be declared even when the traveler believes they fall within a duty-free exemption.
Declaring an item does not automatically mean duty will be owed.
Failure to declare restricted or dutiable goods can lead to seizure, penalties or other enforcement consequences.
